title: 「3COINS」が見出した商機　災害への備え「脱・後回し」の鍵は
extracted_text: 必要なのはわかるけど、後回しになりがち――。災害への備えについて、そんな悩みを解決しつつ、商機につなげようとの取り組みが企業に広がりつつある。鍵は、日常と災害時の境目を取り払った「普段使い」だ。 東京・原宿。SNSで「バズる」商品をたびたび世に送り出す全国展開の「3COINS（スリーコインズ）」本店には、ハンディーファン（小型の扇風機）やキッチン用品、アクセサリーが並ぶ。 災害が頻発し、防災用品の需要は高まっている。ただ、災害時のみを想定した商品は、購入後、押し入れや倉庫にしまい込まれてしまうケースも多い。 こだわりの部屋やインテリアの中に置いても違和感が出にくく、普段使いできる防災用品を求める声に、商機を見いだした。「3COINSならではの手に取りやすい価格とデザインで他社と差別化した商品群にできる」（商品部の担当者）。2023年3月から販売を始めた。
translated_text: We know it's necessary, but it tends to get postponed ——. Companies are increasingly working to solve this common frustration about disaster preparedness and turn it into a business opportunity. The key is "everyday use," which eliminates the boundary between normal times and disaster situations. Tokyo, Harajuku. The flagship store of the nationwide chain "3COINS," known for frequently producing viral products on social media, stocks handheld fans, kitchenware, and accessories. With disasters occurring more frequently, demand for disaster preparedness products is rising. However, products designed solely for emergency situations often end up stored away in closets or warehouses after purchase. A business opportunity was spotted in the growing demand for disaster preparedness items that can be used on a daily basis without looking out of place in a carefully styled room or interior. "We can differentiate our product lineup from competitors with 3COINS' accessible price point and design," says a representative from the product department. Sales began in March 2023.
title_en: "3COINS" Uncovers Business Opportunity: The Key to Breaking the Habit of Postponing Disaster Preparedness
